A first native implementation proposal could therefore suppress the architecture/verifier fallback roles even though federation would later reject that proposal.
changes: Make nativeProposalExecutable honor the browser-plan invalid/overflow flags already emitted by normalizeProposal.
Preserve configured candidate-count behavior and all existing non-browser fallback semantics.
